WoW 3.3.5a addon · version 0.1

Every item the merchant sells, in one window.

Instead of pages of ten — one scrollable list, sorted into groups that make sense for that particular merchant. It opens by itself when you talk to a merchant.

Download How to install
  • 3.3.5a · WotLK
  • English and Russian

Commands

/vendor off
Bring back the stock merchant window. Back again — /vendor on.
/vendor theme flat
Flat dark theme. Client textures — /vendor theme vanilla.
/vendor reset
Forget window sizes for every merchant.
/vendor about
Version, links and other manacode addons. Plain /vendor — addon status.

Every merchant gets its own layout

Groups are picked from the goods, not from the merchant's name: emblems, gems, recipes and mounts are each laid out their own way. Screenshots are from a Russian client; the addon speaks English too.

Features Find it, check it, buy it

  1. Sets as a grid

    Tier and arena pieces are collected into their set: one row per slot, upgrade steps side by side, short labels like T10.2 and A7. Repeated words are trimmed — the full name stays in the tooltip and in search.

  2. Groups for the merchant

    Gems by color, armor by type, recipes by what they make, a quartermaster's goods by reputation rank. Name search also handles the wrong keyboard layout.

  3. "Not for me" filter

    Other classes, the wrong armor and stats, other professions' reagents, old ranks, weak food. Tick it once — only your things stay on the counter.

  4. What you own, what you can afford

    A check mark on what is in your bags, bank or equipped. The price turns red when you are short, and the "Used for" tooltip tells which recipe needs a reagent.

  5. Bulk x5, x20, x100

    Hover an item for the bulk buttons. Before you buy you see how many stacks land in your bags and the total price.

  6. Emblem exchange in one click

    The whole path to the emblem or item you want — in one row. Emblems you already hold midway are used first.

  • Sell gray junk
  • Buyback on its own tab
  • Repair with your gold or the guild bank
  • Emblem refunds on right-click, Bagnon too
  • Tiles or rows, two themes
  • Window size per merchant

Install How to install

Two ways: the updater installs and updates for you, the archive is by hand.

ManacodeUpdate

  1. Download and run the updater.
  2. Press Install next to Vendor.
  3. Log in and talk to a merchant.
Download the updater

By hand

  1. Download the archive from the release page.
  2. Unpack it here: game folder\Interface\AddOns
  3. Fully restart the game and talk to a merchant.
Releases on GitHub
